name: Fort Greene Chaplains
description: A Black street gang based in the Fort Greene housing projects in Brooklyn, active from the early 1950s. One of the most active and notorious of Brooklyn's loosely affiliated Chaplains factions, which also included the Marcy, DeKalb, Brevoort, and Albany Chaplains. Shared turf with the Mau Maus (a Puerto Rican gang) in the Fort Greene projects and was involved in repeated violent conflicts, including clashes with the Bishops and the Suicide Mau Maus. Members were known for wearing distinctive feathered hats as a symbol of status.
